literal: In the seventh month Shenwu sent Zhou Wen a letter charging him with the crime of killing Emperor Xiaowu.
idiomatic: In the seventh month Gao Huan sent Yuwen Tai a letter accusing him of murdering Emperor Xiaowu.

literal: In the eighth month, on the xinwei day, the Wei emperor edicted Shenwu as Chancellor, Recorder of the Secretariat, and Grand Eastern Headquarters, the rest as before; he firmly declined and the appointment ceased.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinwei day, the Wei emperor offered Gao Huan the posts of chancellor, recorder of the Secretariat, and grand eastern headquarters, with all other honors unchanged; he firmly declined and the offer was withdrawn.

literal: That month Shenwu ordered a fort built on the northern mountains of Sizhou, west from Maling Garrison and east to Shidi; the work was finished in forty days.
idiomatic: That month Gao Huan ordered a fort built on the northern mountains of Sizhou, from Maling Garrison in the west to Shidi in the east; the work was completed in forty days.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the jimao day, Shenwu attended court at the capital; on the gengchen day he returned to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jimao day, Gao Huan attended court at the capital; on the gengchen day he returned to Jinyang.

literal: In the third month of the second year, on the guisi day, Shenwu toured Ji and Ding provinces and thereupon attended court at the capital.
idiomatic: In the third month of the second year, on the guisi day, Gao Huan toured Ji and Ding provinces and then attended court at the capital.

literal: Because winter and spring had been severely drought-stricken, he requested remission of outstanding debts, relief for the destitute, and pardon for offenses below the death penalty.
idiomatic: Because winter and spring had brought severe drought, he asked that outstanding debts be remitted, the destitute relieved, and all offenses short of capital punishment pardoned.

literal: He also requested that wooden-plaque offices be conferred on the aged, each according to rank.
idiomatic: He also asked that honorary wooden-plaque offices be granted to the elderly, each according to rank.

literal: In the fourth month, on the bingchen day, Shenwu returned to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the fourth month, on the bingchen day, Gao Huan returned to Jinyang.

literal: In the eleventh month Shenwu campaigned against the Mountain Hu, defeated and pacified them, and captured more than ten thousand households, whom he distributed among the provinces.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month Gao Huan campaigned against the Mountain Hu, defeated and pacified them, and took more than ten thousand households captive, distributing them among the provinces.

literal: In the first month of the third year, on the jiawu day, Open-Office Protocol-Equal Third Rank Erzhu Wenchang, Open-Office Chief of Staff Ren Zhou, Commander Zheng Zhongli, Central Headquarters Registrar Li Shilin, and former Open-Office Staff Officer Fang Ziyuan plotted to assassinate Shenwu; on the night of the fifteenth they beat drums and entered with blades hidden, but their associate Xue Jixiao reported them, and all were executed.
idiomatic: In the first month of the third year, on the jiawu day, Erzhu Wenchang, open-office protocol-equal of the third rank, Open-Office Chief of Staff Ren Zhou, Commander Zheng Zhongli, Central Headquarters Registrar Li Shilin, and former Open-Office Staff Officer Fang Ziyuan plotted to assassinate Gao Huan; on the night of the fifteenth they beat drums and entered with hidden blades, but their associate Xue Jixiao betrayed them, and all were put to death.

literal: On the dingwei day Shenwu requested that a Jinyang Palace be established in Bing Province to house allocated households.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day Gao Huan asked that a Jinyang Palace be built in Bing Province to house allocated households.

literal: In the third month, on the yiwei day, Shenwu attended court at Ye; on the bingwu day he returned to Jinyang.
idiomatic: In the third month, on the yiwei day, Gao Huan attended court at Ye; on the bingwu day he returned to Jinyang.

literal: In the tenth month, on the dingmao day, Shenwu memorialized that You, An, and Ding provinces on the north bordered the Xi and Rouran, and requested that forts and garrisons be built at strategic points for defense; he personally inspected them, and none was left unsound.
idiomatic: In the tenth month, on the dingmao day, Gao Huan memorialized that You, An, and Ding provinces on the north bordered the Xi and Rouran, and asked that forts and garrisons be built at strategic points for defense; he personally inspected them, and none was left unsound.

literal: On the yiwei day Shenwu requested that Mangshan captives be released from bonds and paired with widows among the people.
idiomatic: On the yiwei day Gao Huan asked that Mangshan captives be freed from their bonds and matched with widows among the people.

literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year, on the guisi day, Shenwu prepared to campaign west and assembled his troops at Jinyang after leaving Ye.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year, on the guisi day, Gao Huan prepared to campaign west and assembled his troops at Jinyang after leaving Ye.

literal: Palace Guard General Cao Weizu said: "It cannot be done.
idiomatic: Palace Guard General Cao Weizu said, "It cannot be done.

literal: Now in the eighth month the Western Quarter holds the kingship; with the qi of death opposing the qi of life, it is unfavorable for the guest and favorable for the host.
idiomatic: In the eighth month the Western Quarter holds the kingship; with the breath of death opposing the breath of life, it is unfavorable for the invader and favorable for the defender.

literal: If the army goes forth, the great general will be wounded.
idiomatic: If the army marches, the great general will be wounded.

literal: " Shenwu did not listen.
idiomatic: Gao Huan did not listen.

literal: From the time Eastern and Western Wei took up arms, at Ye there were always first yellow and black ant armies in battle array; diviners held that yellow was the color of Eastern Wei's battle dress and black that of Western Wei, and people used this to read victory and defeat.
idiomatic: From the time Eastern and Western Wei took up arms, at Ye yellow and black ant armies always fought first in battle array; diviners held that yellow was the color of Eastern Wei's battle dress and black that of Western Wei, and people used this to read victory and defeat.

literal: At this time all the yellow ants died.
idiomatic: This time all the yellow ants died.

literal: In the ninth month Shenwu besieged Yubi to provoke the Western army, but they did not respond.
idiomatic: In the ninth month Gao Huan besieged Yubi to provoke the Western army, but they did not respond.

literal: Western Wei Jin Province Inspector Wei Xiaokuan held Yubi; the city sent out iron-faced warriors, and Shenwu had Yuan Dao shoot at them, each time striking the eyes.
idiomatic: Western Wei Jin Province Inspector Wei Xiaokuan held Yubi; the city sent out iron-masked warriors, and Gao Huan had Yuan Dao shoot at them, each time striking the eyes.

literal: Using Li Yexing's solitary-and-empty technique, he massed his forces on the north.
idiomatic: Using Li Yexing's solitary-and-empty divination, he massed his forces on the north.

literal: The north is heaven's barrier.
idiomatic: The north is heaven's barrier.

literal: Thereupon he raised earthen mounds and dug ten tunnels, and on the east side dug twenty-one more to attack.
idiomatic: He raised earthen mounds and dug ten tunnels, and on the east side dug twenty-one more to attack.

literal: The city had no water and drew it from the Fen River.
idiomatic: The city had no water and drew it from the Fen River.

literal: Shenwu had the Fen diverted, and the work was finished in one night.
idiomatic: Gao Huan had the Fen diverted, and the work was finished in one night.

literal: Xiaokuan seized and held the earthen mound; the army encamped fifty days, yet the city was not taken; seventy thousand died and were heaped into one mound.
idiomatic: Xiaokuan seized and held the earthen mound; the army encamped fifty days, yet the city was not taken; seventy thousand died and were heaped into one mound.

literal: A star fell in Shenwu's camp; the donkeys all brayed together, and the soldiers were all seized with fear.
idiomatic: A star fell in Gao Huan's camp; the donkeys all brayed together, and the soldiers were seized with fear.

literal: Shenwu fell ill.
idiomatic: Gao Huan fell ill.

literal: In the eleventh month, on the gengzi day, he was carried back in his litter as the army withdrew.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the gengzi day, he was carried back in his litter as the army withdrew.

literal: On the gengxu day he dispatched the Duke of Taiyuan, Yang, to hold Ye.
idiomatic: On the gengxu day he dispatched the Duke of Taiyuan, Gao Yang, to hold Ye.

literal: On the xinhai day he summoned the heir Cheng to Jinyang.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day he summoned the heir Gao Cheng to Jinyang.

literal: An ill-omened bird perched on a pavilion tree; the heir had Hulü Guang shoot and kill it.
idiomatic: An ill-omened bird perched on a pavilion tree; the heir had Hulü Guang shoot and kill it.

literal: On the jimao day, because he had achieved nothing, Shenwu memorialized to resign as supreme commander of all armies at home and abroad; the Wei emperor issued a gracious edict permitting it.
idiomatic: On the jimao day, because the campaign had failed, Gao Huan memorialized to resign as supreme commander of all armies at home and abroad; the Wei emperor graciously permitted it.

literal: At that time Western Wei said Shenwu had been struck by a crossbow bolt; when Shenwu heard this, he forced himself to sit upright and receive the nobles, had Hulü Jin compose the "Chile Song," and Shenwu harmonized with it, weeping from sorrow.
idiomatic: At that time Western Wei said Gao Huan had been struck by a crossbow bolt; when he heard this, he forced himself to sit upright and receive the nobles, had Hulü Jin compose the "Chile Song," and harmonized with it, weeping from sorrow.

literal: Hou Jing had always looked down on the heir; he once told Chief of Staff Ziru: "While the king lives I dare not differ; when the king is gone I cannot serve with a Xianbei boy.
idiomatic: Hou Jing had always looked down on the heir; he once told Chief of Staff Ziru, "While the king lives I dare not differ; when the king is gone I cannot serve with a Xianbei boy.

literal: " Ziru covered his mouth.
idiomatic: Ziru covered his mouth.

literal: At this time the heir wrote in Shenwu's name to summon Jing.
idiomatic: At this time the heir wrote in Gao Huan's name to summon Jing.

literal: Jing had earlier agreed with Shenwu that when he received a letter, a slight dot on the back meant he should come.
idiomatic: Jing had earlier agreed with Gao Huan that when he received a letter, a slight dot on the back meant he should come.

literal: The letter arrived without a dot, and Jing did not come.
idiomatic: The letter arrived without a dot, and Jing did not come.

literal: He also heard that Shenwu was ill and thereupon gathered troops to hold himself secure.
idiomatic: He also heard that Gao Huan was ill and thereupon gathered troops and fortified himself.

literal: Shenwu said to the heir: "Though I am ill, your face still shows extra worry — why?
idiomatic: Gao Huan said to the heir, "Though I am ill, your face still shows extra worry — why?

literal: " The heir did not answer.
idiomatic: The heir did not answer.

literal: He asked again: "Is it not worry that Hou Jing will rebel?
idiomatic: He asked again, "Is it worry that Hou Jing will rebel?

literal: " He said: "It is so."
idiomatic: He said, "It is so."

literal: Shenwu said: "Jing has monopolized Henan for fourteen years; he has always had a proud and overbearing will, but submitted because I could support him — how could he be driven for you!
idiomatic: Gao Huan said, "Jing has monopolized Henan for fourteen years; he has always had a proud and overbearing will, but submitted because I could support him — how could he be driven for you!

literal: The four quarters are not yet settled — do not hastily announce mourning.
idiomatic: The four quarters are not yet settled — do not hastily announce mourning.

literal: Kudigan Gan, the Xianbei old fellow, and Hulü Jin, the Chile old fellow, are both upright by nature and will never fail you.
idiomatic: Kudigan Gan, the Xianbei old fellow, and Hulü Jin, the Chile old fellow, are both upright by nature and will never fail you.

literal: Kezhuhun Daoyuan and Liu Fengsheng came from afar to join me — they will surely have no different heart.
idiomatic: Kezhuhun Daoyuan and Liu Fengsheng came from afar to join me — they will surely have no different heart.

literal: Heba Yanguo'er is plain and without fault.
idiomatic: Heba Yanguo'er is plain and without fault.

literal: Pan Le was originally a Daoist; his heart is kind and generous — your brothers should gain strength from him.
idiomatic: Pan Le was originally a Daoist; his heart is kind and generous — your brothers should gain strength from him.

literal: Han Gui is somewhat dull — you should treat him leniently.
idiomatic: Han Gui is somewhat dull — you should treat him leniently.

literal: Peng Le is hard to read at heart — you should guard against him.
idiomatic: Peng Le is hard to read at heart — you should guard against him.

literal: Of those who can barely match Hou Jing there is only Murong Shaozong; I therefore did not promote him highly and left him for you — you should grant him exceptional honors and entrust him with strategy."
idiomatic: Of those who can barely match Hou Jing there is only Murong Shaozong; I therefore did not promote him highly and left him for you — you should grant him exceptional honors and entrust him with strategy."

literal: Shenwu's nature was deep, secretive, and lofty; all day long he remained stern, and men could not fathom him.
idiomatic: Gao Huan's nature was deep, secretive, and lofty; all day long he remained stern, and men could not fathom him.

literal: At moments of stratagem he changed like a spirit.
idiomatic: At moments of stratagem he changed like a spirit.

literal: As for the great designs of army and state, he carried them alone in his breast, and civil and military officers rarely shared in them.
idiomatic: As for the great designs of army and state, he carried them alone in his breast, and civil and military officers rarely shared in them.

literal: In commanding armies his laws were strict and solemn; facing the enemy he prevailed, and his stratagems came from nowhere fixed.
idiomatic: In commanding armies his laws were strict and solemn; facing the enemy he prevailed, and his stratagems came from nowhere fixed.

literal: In hearing cases he was clear-sighted and could not be deceived or offended.
idiomatic: In hearing cases he was clear-sighted and could not be deceived or offended.

literal: He knew men and loved scholars, and fully protected those of merit and old service.
idiomatic: He knew men and loved scholars, and fully protected those of merit and old service.

literal: By nature he was thorough and considerate; whenever he issued a civil edict he was always earnest and detailed, speaking to the matter and to the heart, and did not prize ornate language.
idiomatic: By nature he was thorough and considerate; whenever he issued a civil edict he was always earnest and detailed, speaking to the matter and to the heart, and did not prize ornate language.

literal: In raising men and granting office what mattered was obtaining talent; if a man was capable, he might even be pulled up from stable service, while those with empty reputation and no substance were rarely employed.
idiomatic: In raising men and granting office what mattered was obtaining talent; if a man was capable, he might even be pulled up from stable service, while those with empty reputation and no substance were rarely employed.

literal: When generals went out on campaign and followed his plans, none failed to win; when they missed his design, many came to ruin and flight.
idiomatic: When generals went out on campaign and followed his plans, none failed to win; when they missed his design, many came to ruin and flight.

literal: He naturally favored simplicity; swords, saddles, and bridles had no ornament of gold or jade.
idiomatic: He naturally favored simplicity; swords, saddles, and bridles had no ornament of gold or jade.

literal: In youth he could drink heavily, but once he took great responsibility he never passed three cups.
idiomatic: In youth he could drink heavily, but once he took great responsibility he never passed three cups.

literal: At home he was as at office.
idiomatic: At home he was as at office.

literal: He was humane, forgiving, and loving toward scholars.
idiomatic: He was humane, forgiving, and loving toward scholars.

literal: At the beginning, Fanyang Lu Jingyu was famed for mastery of the classics and Lu Commandery Han Yi for skill in calligraphy; both were seized on charges of plotting rebellion, yet both received grace and were housed in his residence to instruct his sons.
idiomatic: At the beginning, Fanyang Lu Jingyu was famed for mastery of the classics and Lu Commandery Han Yi for skill in calligraphy; both were seized on charges of plotting rebellion, yet both received grace and were housed in his residence to instruct his sons.

literal: Many civil and military men who had served their lords to the utmost, once captured, were not punished.
idiomatic: Many civil and military men who had served their lords to the utmost, once captured, were not punished.

literal: Therefore near and far gave him their hearts, and all wished to serve him with effort.
idiomatic: Therefore near and far gave him their hearts, and all wished to serve him with effort.

literal: To the south he awed Liang, to the north he won over the Rouran, and the Tuyuhun and Azhiluo were all brought in by his summons; he gained their strength for use — his design reached far.
idiomatic: To the south he awed Liang, to the north he won over the Rouran, and the Tuyuhun and Azhiluo were all brought in by his summons; he gained their strength for use — his design reached far.

literal: The full text uses the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi, November 1972, as the base for collation.
idiomatic: This text was collated against the Zhonghua Shuju first edition of the Book of Northern Qi (November 1972).
